Introduction

DLTCEP has to be the most powerful tool ever coded to modify the Infinity Engine. Power, though, generally comes with a pricetag and in this case, the cost is an extremely steep learning curve. My first tutorial ('Adding Overlays') was done at the request of Avenger himself after he'd helped me through the maze. Other tutorials followed fairly rapidly; believe it or not, they were written as much to remind me what to do as they were to explain to other people what to do. Having covered some pretty complicated subjects, I then realised I was so far into my mod that I'd forgotten the basics of starting an area with DLTCEP.... :) I was originally going to call the Area Basics tutorial 'Area-Making 101' but then I remembered that there is already a tutorial by that name referring to IETME.

What I can't do is teach you how to think up or design an area - I have to assume that you already have your bitmaps done and ready to go.

My definitions of area making include the following:

  • Actors
  • Ambient sounds
  • Animations
  • Containers
  • Doors and Entrances
  • Environment mapping
  • Info Points, Proximity Triggers, Travel Regions and Traps
  • Spawn areas

-basically the environment that surrounds the party. No one tutorial deals with all of these subjects - each one is/will be the subject of a separate tutorial in its own right (in some cases more than one). Some are already done and the rest will not be done until I have need of that particular subject. These basic tutorials are to get you up and running with DLTCEP so that you can begin modding.

The screenshots throughout these tutorials were taken from the most up-to-date version of DLTCEP at the time. This means that as DLTCEP changes you may find screenshots from more than one version within a single tutorial; in all cases they should represent what you will find in the current version.

Tutorial Contributions for other Editing Subjects

As DLTCEP is such a complex tool and I'm unlikely to cover all topics or discover all wrinkles, I actively welcome contributions to this tutorial site that will cover all aspects of DLTCEP and not just the areamaking that I am concentrating on. I would like to include step-by-step instructions for other things that I am not likely to cover myself, such as spellmaking. I envisage that some externally-contributed tutorials will cover more advanced topics and maybe even just focus on one small aspect of DLTCEP. In that section you may not get the full extent of a step-by-step procedure, although you will get most of them, but I'd expect by then that you would know how to achieve some of the effects without being led by the hand the whole way.

If you'd like to contribute to this knowledge and you understand HTML, I have a simple template that I can email you so that the site retains the look and feel right across all tutorials. If you do not understand HTML, I have a textfile template that, if you follow it, will allow me to automate your contribution into the site template with a minimum of effort. In both cases though, I will be very grateful if you would please proofread your tutorial very carefully. Requests for either template can be sent to me at 'dragonflightdesign {at} hotmail {dot} com'.
